deployment_challenges: Only 10% of enterprise AI use cases successfully scale beyond pilot stage
Complex change management requirements for workforce adaptation
Integration complexity with legacy enterprise systems
performance_constraints: General-purpose agents still struggle with complex, open-ended tasks (14.41% success rate vs 78.24% human performance)
Specialized domain focus required for optimal performance
Continuous monitoring and optimization required for sustained ROI
market_maturity: 80% of companies report no material contribution to earnings from gen AI initiatives
Only 1% of enterprises view their gen AI strategies as mature
Significant implementation and training investments required
